_comment: Evals for the slide-maker SKILL — not for its scripts. The 20 test suites in tests/ all ask
'does this code work'. Nothing asked 'do these 2109 lines of SKILL.md, 35 references and 5
agents make the DECK better', so every claim that a change improved the skill has been an
impression. The repo's own CLAUDE.md says it outright: a lossless refactor can score
2298/2298 and still degrade the skill, because the regression is in WHEN content reaches
context, not whether it survives — and the only real test is running it end to end and
looking at what the output is missing.
Two things this deliberately does NOT do. It does not score taste (no LLM judge, no
aesthetic composite — that path was examined and rejected: reference similarity rewards
imitation and closed-form beauty scores fight this skill's own diversity gates). And it does
not run in PR CI: a run builds a real deck, which is minutes and real tokens.
`reference_reached` is the assertion this file exists for. It answers the one question that
has burned this repo twice — 'was that reference actually READ during the run' — and it can
only be answered from a transcript, never from the artifact.
SCENARIO SELECTION. The later scenarios are chosen by BLIND SPOT, not to reach a count. Each
sits on a defect class this repo has actually shipped and that every existing gate passed
clean — CJK faces, signed native charts, non-16:9 canvases — and each carries an assertion
that did not exist before it. That is the test of whether a scenario earns its place: one
that only re-runs the assertions the earlier scenarios already run measures nothing new, and
twenty of those are not broader coverage, they are a longer bill.
TWO MORE ARE WANTED AND ARE DELIBERATELY ABSENT: template replication and old-deck
restructuring. Both need an INPUT artifact (a .pptx to mimic or to rebuild), and this file has
no mechanism to ship or locate one. An eval whose input does not exist is not reproducible,
and writing it down anyway would inflate the count while measuring nothing. Building that
mechanism is the next piece of work — not a line in this file.

evals.prompt: 我们有一篇做好的论文要在 ISMRM 上做约 10 分钟的口头报告，帮我做演讲幻灯片。论文要点：提出一种基于隐式神经表示（INR）的动态心脏 MRI 重建方法；在 8 倍加速下相比 L+S 基线，PSNR 提升约 2.1 dB、SSIM 达 0.94；消融实验显示时间正则项是关键。我有方法框架图和一张重建对比图可以用。
evals.expected: Interview first (confirm ISMRM track/format, then web-research the venue's rules/aspect/template + style); build a ~6-9 slide talk that reuses the user's two provided figures WHOLE and stays strictly faithful to the given numbers (2.1 dB / 0.94 / time-reg ablation, no invention); run the critic loop to consent.

assertions.why: the two numbers the user supplied must survive onto the slides verbatim
any other figure on a slide was invented — the fidelity floor, mechanised
a presented deck puts the sentences in the notes, not on the slide
the craft reference the build is supposed to design against

evals.prompt: make me some slides about our Q3 results for the leadership team
evals.expected: Identifies purpose = exec/stakeholder readout; interviews (template/source/style); leads with outcome+ask, crisp corporate design (design-by-purpose); critic loop.

assertions.why: an under-specified ask is exactly where the interview must not be skipped

evals.prompt: make a teaching deck on diffusion models, no materials, in English
evals.expected: No-source branch: drafts outline, web-searches to fact-check incl. current-date grounding, confirms outline; teaching rubric (objectives→build→recap); minimal/diagram-heavy.

assertions.why: a no-source deck is research-sourced, so the PRIMARY-SOURCE GATE owes a record
build residue on a slide ships broken

evals.prompt: 我下周要做硕士论文答辩，20 分钟，评审是三位磁共振方向的老师。论文做的是心脏 4D flow MRI 的加速重建：提出一个时空联合的低秩加正则方法，在 12 倍加速下相比 compressed sensing 基线，流速峰值误差从 8.4% 降到 3.1%，重建时间从 6 分钟降到 52 秒。有方法框架图和一张流场对比图。请做答辩幻灯片，中文。
evals.expected: Chinese-language defense deck: interview first, defense rubric (contribution → method → validation → limitations → Q&A backup), the user's two figures reused whole, strictly the given numbers. Every CJK run must declare an East-Asian face.

assertions.why: PowerPoint picks the CJK face from <a:ea>, not <a:latin>. A run that sets only the Latin face renders Chinese through a host substitution — a different face, a different width, and tofu on a machine without the fallback. This repo already shipped a geometry bug from the same asymmetry (every width measured against <a:latin> while the glyphs came from <a:ea>, under-reporting Chinese by ~46%), and no lint here reads the file for it.
the three numbers the user supplied must survive onto the slides verbatim
any other figure on a slide was invented — the fidelity floor, mechanised
the CJK type rules live there, and a Chinese deck built without opening them is the run this scenario exists to catch

evals.prompt: Make a 6-slide deck for our board on FY25 segment performance. Revenue by segment vs last year: Cloud +18.2%, Services +4.6%, Hardware -11.9%, Licensing -3.4%. Group operating margin went from 12.1% to 9.7%. Free cash flow was -$42M in H1 and +$61M in H2. The ask is approval to shift 15 headcount from Hardware to Cloud.
evals.expected: Exec readout: leads with the outcome and the ask, then justifies. The signed series (two negative growth rates, a negative H1 cash flow) must NOT be drawn as a native bar/column chart.

assertions.why: LibreOffice renders a negative column at its ABSOLUTE height, so a -11.9% bar comes out looking exactly like +11.9%. The .pptx is correct, so every check that reads the deck passes; the render is a plausible chart pointing the wrong way, so every check that reads the PNG passes too. This is the one defect class in this repo with no gate at all, and a board deck reading a decline as growth is the worst case it has.
the supplied figures, including the negative ones, must reach the slides
which chart type, and native-vs-raster, is decided there — and native-vs-raster is exactly what this scenario turns on

evals.prompt: 帮我做一组小红书图文，讲「为什么心脏 MRI 要做加速采集」，5 张卡片，面向没有医学背景的读者。
evals.expected: Portrait 3:4 social cards on the `red` format (7.5 x 10 in), not a 16:9 deck exported sideways: one idea per card, big type, self-read density, the format's safe_top/safe_bottom respected.

assertions.why: the whole scenario. Every other canvas assertion in this file is implicitly 16:9, so a pipeline that silently builds 10x5.625 and calls it a 小红书 note passes every existing eval — the format registry exists and nothing tested that it is ever reached.
same East-Asian face rule; this one also checks it survives the non-default canvas path
the per-surface layout DNA — a portrait card is not a wide slide with a different aspect, and this is where that is written
